rationale: Price has steadily crept from the favorable ~$15.82 low back above the entry at $15.89 and is now sitting at $15.94, above the 9-EMA ($15.91) — a structural shift that negates the core short premise of persistent selling pressure below that level. The last several candles show a consistent pattern of higher lows and higher closes with volume picking up on the most recent upswing (64K bar), suggesting buyers are absorbing supply rather than exhausting it. With only $0.08 of buffer remaining before the $16.02 invalidation and momentum pointed against the position, closing here preserves capital and avoids a forced stop-out at a worse price.
